business.description: Prozone Realty Limited (formerly Prozone Intu Properties Limited) is a real estate company that owns and operates retail properties. The company recently acquired full ownership of three key operating subsidiaries by buying out foreign partners' equity.

products.name: Retail Malls
products.note: Operates Prozone Mall, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (6.91 lakh sq ft, 127 stores) and Prozone Mall, Coimbatore (5.01 lakh sq ft, 113 stores). Both assets mature with 94% and 96% occupancy in Q4 FY2026 respectively.

outlook.statement: The company has resolved to monetise assets at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar and Coimbatore for a gross consideration of up to approximately Rs 1,242.50 crore, as holding these properties beyond operational peak would reflect sentiment over strategic discipline.

Strategic shift to consolidate capital by divesting mature retail assets (Coimbatore and Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar malls) for gross consideration up to ~Rs 1,242.50 crore and redirecting capital to Mumbai redevelopment opportunities.

India real estate market projected to reach USD 1,000 billion by 2030 and USD 5.8 trillion by 2047 (KPMG-FICCI); residential pipeline of ~44,277 units by 2030 with sales value of Rs 1,305 billion (Knight Frank).
Mumbai redevelopment market accelerating: 910 society-level agreements registered 2020-H1 2025 unlocking 326.8 acres; 115 agreements in first 5 months of 2025 alone.
MMR retail supply pipeline only ~4 msf through 2031 vs 17.45 msf existing stock; rental growth 15-20% YoY in MMR vs 6-10% nationally for Grade A
Office leasing hit record 83.3 msf in 2025; GCCs >40% of leasing, projected to grow from USD 64 bn (2024) to USD 105-110 bn by 2030
Residential launches to recover 4-7% in FY2027; sales growth 0-3%; ASP growth 4-7%; years-to-sell 1.4-1.6 years by March 2027
Input cost pressure to ease: oil prices -11.8% in 2027, non-fuel commodities +1.3% after +18.6% in 2026
RBI projects real GDP growth 6.6% for FY2026-27; CPI inflation 5.1% peaking at 5.9% in Q3; repo rate likely to hold at 5.25%
